title: The panel names the rest of its controls so a walk can press them
goal: A scripted playtest can now press a button in the right hand panel, but only the ones that have been given a name so far: the Layout section and its pickers. The eye and the lock on a layer row, the colour wells, the Effects buttons and the Frame section are still photographable and not pressable, so a feature that lives in any of them still gets handed over on a picture. This names them, one line each.
notes: Use playtestControl(name) on the control and playtestField(title) on the row that holds it (Sources/Photonz/Playtest/PanelTarget.swift). Segmented pickers need nothing: PlaytestPanelPress reads NSSegmentedControl segments straight off the view tree. Files: LayersPanel.swift (eye, lock), ColorStylePanel.swift, FrameInspector.swift, GeometryInspector.swift. Docs: docs/design/playtest-harness.md, Reaching into the right hand panel.
acceptance: A walk can press the eye and the lock on a named row in the layers list, and the log says which row
A walk can press the buttons in the Effects and Frame sections by the words on them
A panel step lists every one of them with the row it sits on
Scripts/test.sh passes and every existing walk still finishes
